svg.title: Three window pairs over the ten usable days
svg.desc: Train learns from 2022-09-01 to 2022-09-05 and is checked against 09-05 to 09-07. Validate learns from 09-03 to 09-07 and is checked against 09-07 to 09-09. Test learns from 09-05 to 09-09 and is checked against 09-09 to 09-11. Every learning window is four days and every checking window is two, and the boundary between them is strict: a transaction at the exact cutoff instant always counts as the next window's problem, verified by a test that mutates the boundary and requires the leakage check to fail.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: every window is the same length, so a measure means the same thing in all three
